letter:
My dearest Liza, my jaan, my endless sunshine,  
Every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. I still remember the sparkle in your eyes on 23 Feb 2025, and it’s the same sparkle that makes my heart race today. Your laughter is my favorite soundtrack, your smile my favorite view, and your love the compass that guides me home—whether I’m in the desert dunes or under mango trees. Thank you for being my forever cutie, my partner in all adventures.
poem:
In desert dunes or mango shade,  
Your love’s the map that I have made.  
Together, laughter paints the sky,  
With you, my heart will always fly.
